notes.title: Update #1 - 29/11/2017
notes.content:
New Trailer! 
https://youtu.be/KkBsCyxqulo


 Join the Discord! 
https://discord.gg/EqDN6SB
Annoucements from devs and a way to meet other players and arrange to play.


 Join the Steam Group! 
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/theunseencommunity
Useful information and another way to meet fellow players.



 Game: 

 Fixed blinding reflection post process on Industry map
 Can no longer spectate The Unseen as a Swat player
 Fixed client side pre-round freezing
 Fixed occlusion issues with flashing white light when turning corners
 Changed version naming system to make clearer
 Default launch settings now set to windows mode


 Map: 

 Changed sky lighting on sewers and storage to pitch black
 Edited collision for certain actors on trains
 Added extra railings on sewers including around water drainage pit
 Changed windows on Industry
 Made walkthrough wall hole bigger, updated collision
 Removed floating wood on Industry
 Configured post process on Trains
 Updated lighting on Trains
 Updated lighting on Sewers
 Updated lighting on Industry


 Audio: 

 Added team victory sound
 Added team defeated sound


 UI: 

 Added auto refresh after loading server browser menu
 Changed scoreboard to make easier to read quickly
 Changed main menu to make clearer
